name: docker
description: Docker Compose development/runtime conventions for term_5 managed applications.
guidelines: Use named volumes for persistent databases and user uploads that must survive container replacement.
Publish development web ports to 127.0.0.1 unless broader exposure is explicitly requested.
Add health checks or a reliable HTTP health route for the user-facing service.
Generated application containers must not receive the Docker socket.
definition_of_done: User-facing HTTP health probe succeeds after startup.
Normal down/up does not destroy persistent application data.
